Rules: enable_nullable

## Files in the unit

### src/OrderBook/Book.cs

```csharp
using System;
using Syst

edits.search:
Order order = book.Get(id);
            Money total = order.Total();
edits.replace:
Order order = book.Get(id)!; // the ID comes from book.Ids()
            Money? total = order.Total();

arguments.summary: Enable nullable reference types in the library's files: Book.Get, Order.Total, Order.Find and Order.Note can be null and say so; the rest of each file was already null-safe.
review_notes: Report.Table takes each order with book.Get(id)!: the IDs come from book.Ids(), so every one is in the book.
